title: JSOC crash retrievals and Knights of Malta

tellings.quote: According to journalist Seymour Hirsch, one of the modern heads of Joc, General Stanley Mcristel, and many of the members of JOC themselves are all Knights of Malta.

plain: Jesse Michels says that, according to the journalist Seymour Hersh, General Stanley McChrystal, a former head of JSOC, the Joint Special Operations Command that runs the US military's elite special forces units, and many of JSOC's own members are Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knighthood. Michels raises it in an episode with a former presidential adviser who says he handled UFO material, as part of a story that links JSOC to recovering crashed craft, which would put that work in the hands of a small, tightly bound circle.
